paragraphs: A Land Rover Ford EcoBoost engine rebuild starts from £3,600, regardless of which of the six models it's fitted to — the price tier is set by the engine, not the badge on the boot. A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available.
Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required — submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes.

cards.title: Rebuilding Your
cards.body: Most engine suppliers sell you a used engine of unknown history and hope it matches. We rebuild the engine your Land Rover already has instead — strip it down, pressure-test it, and replace every worn or damaged component with updated OEM parts. You get a near-new engine with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty, without the compatibility risk of an unknown used unit. This is the option most Ford EcoBoost owners choose.

cards.title: Replacement
cards.body: If your existing engine is beyond economical repair, we also offer full engine replacement and fitting — sourced and fitted by our team, with the same 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

cards.title: Used
cards.body: In some cases, a matched low-mileage used engine is the right call — particularly if you need your car back on the road quickly and your existing engine's damage is extensive. We can source and fit these too, though most owners who ask about used engines end up choosing a rebuild once they understand the compatibility risk a used unit carries.

options.body: "Reconditioned" is the term many owners search for when they mean the same thing as a rebuild — a full strip-down, inspection, and replacement of worn parts rather than a straight swap. If that's what you're after, our rebuild service is exactly that.
"Refurbished" often describes the same process from a different angle — restoring your existing engine to full working condition rather than replacing it outright. Our rebuild covers this.

Some owners specifically search for a "remanufactured" engine, expecting a unit rebuilt to original specification with updated components. That's consistent with what our rebuild service delivers, regardless of which of the six Ford EcoBoost-equipped models you drive.

faqLeft.q: What is the Land Rover Ford EcoBoost engine?
faqLeft.a: The Ford EcoBoost 2.0 — also known as the Ford GTDI — is a turbocharged 2.0-litre inline-four petrol engine used in earlier Land Rover models as an alternative to the Ingenium petrol engine.

faqLeft.q: Which Land Rover models use the Ford EcoBoost?
faqLeft.a: Discovery Sport (L550, 2015–2019), Freelander (L359, 2013–2014) and Range Rover Evoque (L538, 2013–2019) — all as the Si4 petrol variant.

faqLeft.q: Does the EcoBoost differ between Land Rover models?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The specific ancillaries and mounting differ by application, even though the base engine is the same. We match by registration/VIN before confirming any rebuild or replacement.

faqLeft.q: Is an EcoBoost from one Land Rover model compatible with another?
faqLeft.a: Not automatically. An EcoBoost from an Evoque isn't a drop-in match for one from a Discovery Sport — ancillaries and mounting differ. We always confirm compatibility by registration/VIN.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover Ford EcoBoost engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,200. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.
Yes. We work on EcoBoost rebuilds across every Land Rover model it's fitted to, replacing worn components as standard.

faqRight.q: What are the common issues with the Ford EcoBoost?
faqRight.a: Timing chain stretch is a known issue — rattling at startup is a telltale sign. Turbocharger issues and carbon buildup on intake valves are also common on higher-mileage examples.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Land Rover Ford EcoBoost engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Land Rover if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an EcoBoost engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your vehicle arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most EcoBoost owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.
